text: The balance after the guaranteed share is composed, not stored. The close activity reads the balance of the accounts of the case from recovery.v_ace_account at the ACE batch date and subtracts the guaranteed share the answered GUARANTEE row names; the result is tested against zero for R-GUA-26 and against greater than zero for R-GUA-25, and it is carried as the balanceAfterShare field of the GuaranteeClose element with the batch date in balancesAsAt. No share column, no balance column, no position column and no fixed share is added or asserted, and the composition is the working read until the owner publishes the field or the row.
why: R-GUA-26 and R-GUA-25 decide on "the balance after the guaranteed share", and no source gives either the share or the balance a column, a field identifier or a governed row, so the stories cannot read one and must not invent one.

text: The close of a guarantee is recorded as the claim result plus the GuaranteeClose element with its closing basis, and the close of the case is the case status GUARANTEE_CLOSED or RESIDUAL_TO_ROUTE that rwb-case applies from the stage report. No value is added to LOV-CLAIM-STATUS, which stays PREPARING, FILED, DEFECT, PAID and REJECTED, no case row and no case task is written by this service, and no Kafka event is published: the step's event is the stage report to the parent CaseWorkflow.
why: The rules say close the guarantee and close the case, the claim list has no closed value, and the case and its closure belong to rwb-case after the split, so both the claim side and the case side must be stated for the stories to be buildable and testable.

text: The close step is entered on the case signal the parent CaseWorkflow forwards to the GuaranteeClaimWorkflow child, carrying the case status, the claim id and the payment reference. The stories add no timer, no scheduled scan and no subscription of their own, and name no event the service does not own; the payment that clears the balance is matched and posted by rwb-payment and reaches the step through the case.
why: FSD S3 offers a completed ACE batch, an event or a timer as the trigger and names none, its background-event table says there is no background event, and the ownership rows give S3 no job and no event.
